# Smart office operations

## People interact with tools for change

|  |
| --- |
| The product concept shifted from “human adaptation tools” to “tool adaptation tools”. |

| Dimensions | Past: human adaptation tools | AI Age: Tools adapted to people |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Interactive | Menu driver and memory command: User needs to know where the function is, remember complex shortcut keys and formula syntax (e.g. VLOOKUP). One-way, mechanical interaction. | Natural language dialogue: direct description of needs in daily languages, e.g. summary of Q3 procurement costs. Two-way, understanding interactive. |
| Goal achieved | Manual operations and step-by-step: Each operation requires a gradual user, starting from scratch and relying on the professional skills of the user. | Intended understanding and automated generation: Users propose targets, AI automatically executes a series of complex operations. |
| Processes and collaboration | Inflexible processes: collaborative processes are fixed, information is isolated and cross-application data requires manual handling. | AI Working stream understanding context: automatically generate minutes after meetings and distribute them to the person concerned; extract task items from mail and automatically add them to the to-do list. Tools proactively connect to workflows and break barriers to application. |
| Data processing and analysis | Dependence on expertise: Deep data analysis skills are required. Users must know what formula is used and which chart best reflects the value of the data, and the conclusions depend on manual discovery. | Smart Insight and Visualization: All users need is data, and AI can automatically analyse trends, detect anomalies, make assumptions and recommend appropriate visualization options. |
| Learning costs | One-size-fits-all interfaces and high learning costs: all users face the same interfaces and functions, with limited individualized settings; skilled use of advanced functionality requires long-term learning and training. | Self-adaptation interfaces and learning curves close to zero: AI learns user habits, prioritizes common functions, and thousands of people. |

## Next generation smart office

| Core concepts | Product claims |
| --- | --- |
| Agent, service. Everyone has an AI partner. | Carbon-based employee + Silicon-based employee = multiplication of team effectiveness |

### Structure

| System Level | Component | Main roles |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Interactive entrance | A dialogue box | Users present tasks and targets in natural languages |
| Smart synergies | A group of Agents. | AI experts in different positions perform their tasks in a coordinated and professional manner |
| Data Support | A global data network | Connect enterprise internal systems, non-systemic information and external data |

### Example of dialogue synergy

| Synergies | Participating role | Division of tasks |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Mission launch. | User | Presenting the Analysis Q1 New Product Listing Program |
| Budget and cost | Finance specialists | Responsible for budget refinement and cost analysis |
| Compliance analysis | Legal expert | Responsible for compliance risk assessment |
| Resource allocation | Personnel specialists | Responsible for team resource allocation |
| Client information | Customer service specialists | Responsible for client feedback data integration |
| Integrated implementation | System | Call in-house and external data and coordinate mission assignments |

### Global data network

| Data Level | Data content |
| --- | --- |
| Enterprise external data | Government data, academic papers, periodical literature, patent literature, standard norms, white papers, industry research |
| Enterprise internal system data | Process data, project data, operational data |
| Intra-enterprise non-systemic data | Independent documents, audio and video, chat records |
| Data-processing layer | External API call, data source listening, data reporting port, data storage system |

## Product System Overview

### Seven Product Site Solutions

| Product scene | Core competencies |
| --- | --- |
| Customer relationship management | Sales, business opportunities, customers, orders, AI experts. |
| Organisation | Team communication, enterprise security. |
| Personnel management | Recruitment, remuneration, attendance, staff relations. |
| Administration | Asset management, automation of processes. |
| Procurement management | Vendor comparison, compliance audit, budget control. |
| Financial results | Real-time reporting, automated reconciliation, AI financial insight, tax compliance. |
| Meetings | A narrowband of high-resolution, AI smart conference summaries, real-time multilingual subtitles, intelligent scheduling, enterprise-level security. |
